title: Acme dashboard: navigation refresh
intro: Same screens, same seeded data, before and after the refresh. Taste rows need a yes/no; bug rows are fixes to confirm.

rows.title: 1 · Inbox
rows.text: Rows are denser and the unread dot moved left of the sender, so more messages fit above the fold.

rows.title: 2 · Settings
rows.text: The billing panel no longer hides the Save button on narrow windows.
